articles.title: James Gunn Likes a Fan's DC Timeline
articles.summary: James Gunn praised a fan's timeline of the DC Universe, calling it pretty good.

articles.title: Djokovic Loses and Misses the ATP Finals
articles.summary: Novak Djokovic lost to qualifier Rinky Hijikata in Paris, ending his hopes of reaching the ATP Finals.

articles.title: Bob Dylan Meets the Pope
articles.summary: Bob Dylan met Pope Leo XIV at the Vatican on Wednesday, a brief visit between concert dates in Italy.
